zh: 关闭窗口后如何处理？最小化到托盘后，仍会继续统计流量。
en: What should happen when you close the window? Collection continues in the tray.

zh: 您有尚未保存的更改。退出后，这些更改将丢失。
en: Your changes have not been saved. Exiting will discard them.

zh: 旧数据尚未导入。是否先恢复当前统计？您可以稍后再导入旧数据。
en: Old data has not been imported. Resume collection now? You can import old data later.

zh:
发现相同网络和日期的记录。

将保留当前数据库已有日期的记录，只导入其余旧日期，不会相加或覆盖。旧数据原文及导入前备份均会保留。
en:
Some network dates already exist.

Keep existing dates and import only the remaining dates, without adding to or overwriting existing records. Original files and recovery backups are retained.
